node.title: XR threshold quotient image localizes to one-point-tail tangents
node.statement: For one quotient fiber size and A>=k+1, every noncontained quotient-remainder support above agreement A has a profile-preserving noncontained one-point deletion unless it has remainder one and its pure-fiber predecessor is contained. Iteration shows that the threshold quotient slope image is exactly the union of the exact-A image and these remainder-one boundary factors. Every boundary factor is a genuine tangent to the predecessor's codeword pair; this node alone does not own their union.
